notes.title: Major Update! Kawaii Neko Girls v2.0 New Girl: Sakura! Achievements, and More!
notes.content:
[h1]Are you ready for even more fun with Kawaii Neko Girls? [/h1]
Our latest update is packed with exciting new features, including a bonus character, Sakura, who is available only to players of our newest game release: Kawaii Neko Girls 2. You can earn new achievements with Yudzuki, Sakura and something else!

[h1]Our new game Kawaii Neko Girls 2 JUST released![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1794330/Kawaii_Neko_Girls_2/

[h1]Meet the Character, Sakura![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40826401/214fa5ce69f57a8fc69e6a3dc8e49a16b75ed351.png[/img]
Sakura is lying on a bed in a sexy dress and provocative pose. She is exceptionally beautiful and has a confident and alluring expression, suggesting she is comfortable in her sexy body and enjoys being desired.

[h2]But that's not all! [/h2]
We've also made significant improvements to the game's interface, such as a new menu and delayed hints that appear after 20 seconds of gameplay. We've also added closed levels indicator that are marked with an lock and updated the character descriptions to give you a more immersive gaming experience.

[h2]In addition[/h2] 
To these updates, we've made several improvements to the game's logic, including limiting the maximum FPS to ~144, and added a window with thanks to the player for playing the game. We've even created a project in OneSkyApp to make it easier for players to contribute to the game's translation.

[h2]But wait[/h2]
There's more! We're excited to announce that we've released a new game! And as a special bonus, players of our new game release Kawaii Neko Girls 2 get exclusive access to Sakura in Kawaii Neko Girls. So what are you waiting for? Join the discussion, help us translate the game, and play our latest game right now!

notes.title: Small Update Kawaii Neko Girls v1.1.1 (Right-click & Random fix button)
notes.content:
[h1]Hi! Today we made a small update due to feedback from our players (especially Nishmo).
[/h1]

We've added the ability to rotate a piece of the puzzle backwards, by right-clicking.
We also changed the functionality of the button, which previously compiled the full image.
Now, by pressing this button, you can fix a random piece of the puzzle. This will not forcing the function of instantly collecting the whole image, but you can also do it by pressing the E Button.

[b]List of changes[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now rotate a piece of the puzzle backwards by right-clicking.
[*] The UI will now have a button to fix a random piece of the puzzle instead of a button to instantly reassemble the puzzle
[*] Minor localization fixes
[*] Fixed few minor bugs
[/list]

[b]Credit List[/b]
Nishmo — Update ideas ❤️

notes.title: Kawaii Neko Girls v0.4 Localization
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! We have been working hard to make our game accessible to a wide range of players and we are ready to announce that most of the text in our game has already been translated into 26 languages.[/h1]

[h2]Mistakes happen.[/h2]
[h3]Unfortunately, we do not have enough resources to provide high quality and fully accurate translations in all languages, but we try to do our best. Therefore we would like to apologize beforehand for possible translation errors. (You always have the possibility to change the language, for example to English, if you are not satisfied with the translation quality.)[/h3]

[h2]How can you help?[/h2]
[h3]If you are willing and able to help us translate our game into your native language, or a language you speak well, we will gladly accept your help. Contact us by creating a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1628760/discussions/]discussion in our community[/url]. In the future, we will create a separate discussion with detailed instructions on how you can help us.[/h3]

[h2]How do I change the language in the game?[/h2]
[h3]In order to manually change the language, if the game could not do it automatically, you need to open the properties of the game in Steam and go to the section with the choice of language. There you can choose any language that will be convenient for you.[/h3]


[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game now automatically detects your language and includes it in the game.
[*] You can change the language manually in the game properties in Steam.
[/list]

notes.title: Kawaii Neko Girls v0.2 View Mode
notes.content:
[h1]Hi everyone, let us introduce you to the new view mode.[/h1]
[h2]To use it, go to the level selection menu and click on the landscape image icon.[/h2]

[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] View Mode.
[*] Use the "N" key to change the viewing mode (clothed/naked) in viewing mode.
[*] Use "Alt" key to hide user interface in viewing mode.
[*] Use "A/D" or "←/→" key to switch between characters in viewing mode.
[*] Hotkey prompts are now displayed in the character selection menu.
[*] Many bugs have been fixed.
[/list]
